Use `snl library update` to replace the mutable fields of an existing Library under revision control.

### Agent procedure
1. Get the exact Library immediately before editing and preserve every field outside the requested change.
2. Pass the complete validated replacement through `--input <file|->` with the current `--if-match` revision.
3. On conflict, reread and merge semantically; never retry with the stale revision.
4. Run `snl validate --root <path> --json` after the write and stop if it reports an error.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl library update` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
